Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for interviewing with us. As discussed on the call, attached is the take-home prompt for the Senior Inference Engineer role. High-level notes:
- Deliverable: short write-up (1–2 pages) + a runnable notebook or pseudocode for the design you propose.
- Timebox: 6 business days (deadline: EOD Thu, 28 May). If you need a short extension, tell us your preferred day.
- Focus areas: throughput tradeoffs, cache strategy, and operational observability (what you'd measure).

Attachment: redwood-takehome-prompt.pdf (7 pages) — includes example inputs and evaluation criteria.

Please reply here to confirm receipt. If you prefer to submit via Google Drive link, send it to dev.patel@redwood.ai and cc evh.
